title: Vehicle Purchase Agreements — Cancellation Before Handover: Reversals, Retentions and Refunds
content:
**1. When an order may be cancelled.** An order under Vehicle Purchase Agreements may be cancelled at any time before handover, from reserved or contracted. The closure reason is one of: customer cancelled, vehicle unavailable, or financing not completed.

**2. Identity.** Before refunds are released, the caller must have passed identity verification on this customer, as shown by the identity verification record.

**3. Reversal of agreement charges.** On cancellation every agreement charge is reversed, except that a shipping fee already charged on a vehicle that has been transferred is retained when the cancellation reason is customer cancelled or financing not completed and the program's shipping fee refundable switch is false. When the cancellation reason is vehicle unavailable, every charge is reversed, the shipping fee included, whatever the program. A charge reversal is posted only on an order whose status is contracted, delivered, completed, cancelled or returned.

**4. Paying a retained shipping fee.** A retained shipping fee is paid first from deposit money still held, through a deposit application on the cancelled order; any deposit left is refunded.

**5. Refunds of customer money.** Customer-paid down payments are refunded to their original channel within the program's cancellation refund business days, less any retained shipping fee the deposit did not cover. Trade equity already applied to the order is refunded to the buyer by ACH. A refund is posted only on an order whose status is cancelled, returned or completed.

**6. Finance money and linked services.** Finance proceeds are never refunded to the buyer: lender proceeds already received are sent back to the lender as a lender proceeds return refund entry. On cancellation, a Kestrel Auto Finance application that is still only approved is withdrawn, and a Kestrel Auto Finance contract that is already active is unwound. Trade-in agreements, title orders and delivery appointments for the order are cancelled.

**7. Financing not completed.** A cancellation for financing not completed is recorded only after the outside lender funding period counted from the purchase agreement signing date has passed. The funding period is counted in calendar days with the signing date as day 0 and ends at the end of its last day.

**Shipping fee on cancellation.**

| Cancellation reason | Shipping fee already charged and vehicle transferred | Program's shipping fee refundable switch | Shipping fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| vehicle unavailable | any | any | reversed |
| customer cancelled | yes | false | retained |
| customer cancelled | yes | true | reversed |
| financing not completed | yes | false | retained |
| financing not completed | yes | true | reversed |

**Funding period boundary (hypothetical, 10-day funding period).** Signing on day 0 puts the last day of the period at day 10. A cancellation for financing not completed may be recorded on day 11; on day 10 the period has not yet passed.

**Worked example (hypothetical).** A Kestrel Certified order with a $500.00 deposit still held, a $799.00 shipping fee charged after the vehicle was transferred, and a $4000.00 ACH down payment is cancelled at the customer's request. Kestrel Certified does not refund a charged shipping fee, so the fee is retained and every other agreement charge is reversed. The $500.00 held deposit is applied against the fee, leaving $299.00 uncovered, and the down payment refund is $4000.00 less $299.00, that is $3701.00, back to the ACH account within 5 business days.
